common.tagline: Learn to code by doing — guided, never given

landing.heroSubtitle: Paste your exercise, code in the browser, and progress with a tutor that guides without ever giving the full solution.
landing.step1Desc: Type, paste or upload a file (PDF, image, docx). AI structures it for you.
landing.step2Desc: Lightweight editor + Python in the browser (Pyodide). Instant feedback, even offline.
landing.step3Desc: Socratic questions, progressive hints, error explanations — never the full answer.
landing.pythonOnly: Launch: Python. Architecture ready for more languages.
landing.principles: Principles: never the full solution, progressive hints, offline-first
landing.pivotSubtitle: New model: teacher creates once, student joins with a code. Practice mode stays available.
landing.teacherCtaDesc: Create an exercise (manual, AI or upload), get a PY-XXXX code and track your class.
landing.studentCtaDesc: Enter the code from the board + your first name. No account, just your code.
landing.practiceToggle: Practice mode — paste my own exercise (no code, not tracked)
landing.practiceHint: The old paste → generate flow stays here for solo practice.

workspace.runTitle: Run YOUR program with the simulated keyboard data below
workspace.testsTitle: Check your program against the exercise examples (like the teacher)
workspace.stdinHelp: Type here what you would type on the keyboard. Each input() reads the next line.
workspace.consoleEmpty: Nothing yet. Write your code then ▶ Run.
workspace.consoleAwaiting: ⏳ Your program is waiting for a value — type it below then Enter:
workspace.inputPromptWarning: 💡 In BAC style, write input() with nothing between the parentheses — remove the text or tests will fail.
